Name: The Chemist - Absolutely No Practical Applications

The Chemist - Absolutely No Practical Applications

Created by: Bentley Playz
Version: 0.6.0-beta
Game: Stardew Valley 1.6.15

Description

Welcome to the laboratory!

The Chemist - Absolutely No Practical Applications brings a science-themed experience to Stardew Valley, featuring the eccentric Dr. Elwood Fizzwick, a custom Chemistry Lab, unusual supplies, custom items, and a private bedroom to discover through friendship.

Meet Elwood, explore his laboratory, browse his Chemical Supply Catalog, and see what happens when scientific curiosity finds its way into the valley.

This is an evolving beta project, with more possibilities for future experiments, features, and improvements.

Science has arrived in Stardew Valley. Whether that's a good idea remains to be seen.

Installation Instructions

1. Install Stardew Valley and ensure your game version is compatible with this release.
2. Install SMAPI if required by the downloadable mod package.
3. Download the mod ZIP from this page.
4. Extract the downloaded archive.
5. Place the actual mod folder containing "manifest.json" into your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder. Do not place the ZIP itself in the folder.
6. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI if the mod requires it.
7. Check the SMAPI console or log for loading errors.

Important: Check the included README and manifest for the exact dependencies and installation structure before installing. Back up your save before testing a beta mod.

Main Features

🧪 A Custom Chemistry Lab

Explore a science-themed location created for Dr. Elwood Fizzwick and his unusual research.

👨‍🔬 Meet Dr. Elwood Fizzwick

Get to know the scientist at the center of the mod through his character, dialogue, and relationship content.

🛏️ Elwood's Private Bedroom

Version 0.6.0-beta introduces a separate bedroom with custom pixel-art furniture and decorations. Access is tied to your friendship with Elwood.

🧴 Chemical Supply Catalog

Browse the Chemical Supply Catalog for the merchandise supported by the mod. Catalog access is designed to remain useful even when Elwood is unavailable.

🍔 Custom Items and Recipes

Discover the custom items and recipes included in the project, adding a little experimental flavor to everyday Stardew Valley gameplay.

🎭 Character and Festival Content

The project includes existing dialogue, relationship content, and festival-related additions. Some behavior remains subject to further in-game verification.

🎨 Custom Pixel Art

The laboratory and bedroom use custom visual assets designed to fit the Stardew Valley-inspired aesthetic.

Requirements

- Stardew Valley: Version 1.6.15 is the target version for this release.
- SMAPI: Install the version compatible with your game if required by the package.
- Content Patcher: Required only if listed as a dependency in the included manifest.
- Other dependencies: Follow the requirements listed in the included "manifest.json" and README.

Please check the actual downloadable archive for the definitive dependency list before installation.

Beta Notice

Version 0.6.0-beta has passed static file validation, but it has not been tested in-game.

Some behavior, including the bedroom entrance, friendship condition, NPC schedule, shop availability, and displayed character name, remains unverified. Features may not behave as intended, and bugs or compatibility issues may occur.

If you encounter a problem, please include your Stardew Valley version, SMAPI version, steps to reproduce the issue, and relevant SMAPI logs.

Shout Outs

A huge thank-you to the Stardew Valley community and the modding community for the documentation, tools, tutorials, and examples that help creators build new experiences.

Special thanks to everyone who tests mods, reports bugs, shares feedback, and helps make community-created content better.

And thank you to everyone checking out this project and supporting Bentley Playz.

Finally, a special mention to Dr. Elwood Fizzwick himself: may his experiments be interesting, his laboratory stay standing, and his practical applications remain questionable.

Manifest.Name: The Chemist: Absolutely No Practical Applications
Manifest.Description: Adds The Chemist, a mad-science laboratory near the Spa on the Railroad map, Dr. Elwood Fizzwick (a marriageable NPC) with his own daily schedule, six useless chemical products with friendship-unlocked recipes, Fizzwick's Experimental Beer (also sold at Gus's Stardrop Saloon), the Tide Pod Ring, a laboratory supply counter (normal shop menu, separate from talking to Elwood), Elwood's Chemical Supply Catalog (100g; lets you use the counter when Elwood is out), a one-time starter bundle letter and one welcome letter. Elwood also appears at the Flower Dance (as a spectator), the Luau and Spirit's Eve. New in 0.6.0: Elwood's private bedroom inside the lab (opens at 1 heart; he sleeps there from about 10 PM to 6 AM; the counter closes while he sleeps unless you own the catalog) and Mayor Lewis is now displayed as Mr. Mayor Lewis. Content Patcher only; no DLL, no C#.
Manifest.Author: Bentley Playz
